recognize_zh: 這是軸狀面增強後 MRI：橘色箭頭指向中腦被蓋區（影像右側，即病人左側）一個小的點狀顯影病灶，在骨髓瘤病人要想到中樞神經髓外病灶（CNS EMD）；這是影像而非形態學圖片。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced T1-weighted brain MRI at the level of the midbrain
Small punctate enhancing focus in the left midbrain tegmentum (orange arrow)
No mass effect or surrounding edema appreciable on this single slice
No obvious dural or leptomeningeal thickening on this slice
Imaging alone cannot establish plasma cell origin
describe_en: Axial post-contrast T1-weighted MRI of the brain demonstrates a small, punctate enhancing focus in the left midbrain tegmentum (arrow), without appreciable mass effect on this image. No definite dural-based mass or leptomeningeal enhancement is evident on this single slice. In a patient with plasma cell myeloma, this is suggestive of central nervous system extramedullary disease, which should be confirmed by CSF cytology (plasma cells on cytospin) and flow cytometry, as vascular, infectious, and demyelinating lesions can appear similar.
